label: Soft Workspace
description: Light, human internal tool shell for team apps and everyday workspaces. Soft panels and clear type — not a dense admin CRM and not a neon dark cockpit.
signatureMotif: light panels, large friendly type, and quiet pastel action color
promptHints: Build a light app chrome: pale sidebar, generous list rows, and a single pastel primary. This is a daily team tool, not an ops terminal.
Prefer readable empty states and plain-language buttons (Skapa, Dela, Klart) over icon-only toolbars.
Keep density low: one task in focus, not a packed CRM table.

layouts: Shell is a light left nav (soft gray, 14–15px labels with a small leading icon) plus a content pane with a large page title and one primary action top-right.
Lists are spacious rows (min-h-14) with avatar, title, one meta line, and a quiet status pill — not compact data tables.
Detail views use a single column of soft cards with 16–20px padding and a sticky footer action bar, not a 3-pane inspector.
Empty states are illustrated lightly with one sentence and one button, centered in the content pane.
motifs: Background is warm gray-white; cards are white with 0.9–1rem radius and a hairline border, almost no shadow.
Primary is a muted teal or periwinkle — never neon, never black full-bleed headers.
Plus Jakarta Sans for titles; Inter for UI. Iconography stays outline, 20px, low contrast.
antiPatterns: Do not use immersive-dark or quantum neon: glowing borders, particle fields, or near-black chrome.
Avoid clean-utility dense admin: tiny 12px tables, packed filter bars, and spreadsheet-like CRM density.
No glassmorphism overlays, metric-sparkline walls, or terminal fonts in the shell.
